query:
SELECT id, name, fitScore, urgencyScore,
  CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END as brief_status,
  CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END as sales_status
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003) 
AND (briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' OR salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '');
